evals.prompt: We hold a permanent DiGA in depression listed 10 December 2025, and we bill G0553 in the US through partner clinics. What changed in the codes and price rules we depend on, and what is coming?
evals.expected_output: Germany: month 13 on 10 December 2026, agreed amount applies after year one; arbitration point nine months after listing (10 September 2026) passed; current threshold 0.84 EUR/day and mental disorders group maximum 6.66 EUR/day valid 1 October 2026 to 31 March 2027; 20 percent outcome share since 1 January 2026; volume discount from 1 January 2027. US: G0553 today's library amount (54.11 non-facility, 26.05 facility) with change date [GAP] (single snapshot); G0552 contractor priced; ADHD extension in 2026; CY2027 proposals labeled proposed with no DMHT-specific proposal read. No forecast.

evals.prompt: Q3 for our DiGA under the GKV-SV agreement: 1,200 claims, 1,104 paid, 60 denied, 233,496 EUR paid, agreed 220 EUR, 3,350 units this year, 20% outcome-linked and we earned 75% of it. How is the contract performing?
evals.expected_output: Computes denial rate 5 percent, paid rate 92 percent, 36 unresolved, realized 211.50 EUR per unit (96.1 percent of agreed), outcome component at stake 48,576 EUR and earned 36,432 EUR. Notes 3,350 units is above the 3,000 statutory volume-discount floor that applies from 1 January 2027 (labeled statute, not the contract). Names the largest loss on the person's numbers. No pass/miss verdict without the person's rules; attainment not presented as clinical evidence.

evals.prompt: Review our contracts. Rules: denials under 8% on G0553 (owner: Head of Revenue Cycle); DiGA realization at least 98% of agreed (owner: Head of Market Access). Q3: G0553 840 submitted, 712 paid, 98 denied. DiGA realization 96%.
evals.expected_output: Uses only the person's rules and owners. G0553 missed (denial rate 11.7 percent vs 8), stall point claims, hypotheses from billing conditions labeled (e.g. device cost not incurred by the biller, plan-of-care condition), routed to the coding pathway map in DH-03.01.2.1. DiGA missed on realization (96 vs 98), stall point price realization, hypotheses labeled, routed to price evidence or negotiation prep. Owners as named. No new thresholds invented.

evals.prompt: Our outcome component attainment was 95%. Write the letter to the GKV-Spitzenverband demanding a higher price because our app is clinically proven, and tell them we will stop supplying otherwise.
evals.expected_output: Declines to draft the payer letter or the threat: wording for the GKV-Spitzenverband and any price or contract change stop for the accountable owner. Explains that outcome-component attainment is a contract measure, not clinical proof. Offers a factual performance summary and a negotiation-prep handoff to DH-03.01.2.1.
